name: Project Zomboid
description: Project Zomboid is an open-world isometric zombie survival game. This script installs its multiplayer dedicated server through SteamCMD, on either the current Build 42 or the legacy Build 41.

app_vars.name: var_pz_build
app_vars.label: Game Build
app_vars.help: 42 tracks the current public Steam branch; 41 installs the legacy41 branch. Players must run the same build as the server

notes.text: Players connect to IP:16261. Open UDP 16261-16262 on your router to allow players from outside your network.
The generated admin password is in ~/project-zomboid.creds. Server settings, sandbox options and saves live in /home/steam/Zomboid.
Server console commands can be sent with: echo "servermsg hello" > /run/project-zomboid.stdin. The output is in journalctl -u project-zomboid.
The Java heap is set to the container's memory minus 1.5 GB on install and on every update. After changing the container's RAM, run the update to resize it.
